digest.component_or_area: plan-review and code-review discovery gate cutover (RP-06)
propositions: A deterministic shadow comparator must consume observed call/result sets from both legacy and RP-06 projections, report field-level mismatches against an approved delta allowlist, and never issue model calls or control the final verdict.

Repository-policy guards must fail when a review gate bypasses CriteriaSnapshot to read routing directly, when a second discovery scheduler is introduced outside the shared kernel, or when per-unit trace fields enter review/review-status schemas.

A live external provider canary must drive the real default discovery path, assert narrow final verdicts (PASS/BLOCK) with coverage.llm_ran=True and internal journal retained, and print no secrets or prompt bodies.

Cross-gate fixture coverage must validate no overlay, effective disable/retune, scoped/global project LLM, project DET, budget shed, local/systemic failure, cancellation, and legacy checkpoint scenarios produce approved dispositions and trace outcomes.
Public response-schema tests must prove review-plan, review-plan --status, and code-review outputs remain narrow while reducer-ignored journals retain versioned internal traces.
New code must ignore legacy checkpoint envelopes; the retained compatibility projection cannot write new envelopes or decide verdicts; revert rollback requires no journal rewrite or data cleanup.
